item.title: How I Built My Hugo Blog with GitHub Actions — And Fixed Every Mistake Along the Way
item.author: hananmdofficials@gmail.com (Hanan)
item.description: As a 2nd-year Computer Science student at UCSC, I wanted more than just a GitHub repo or LinkedIn profile. I wanted a personal tech blog — something that shows not just what I built, but how I think, what I learned, and how I solve problems.
